'''Baggoth Ironmantle''' was the former marshal of [[Dun Kithas]] and a renowned architect who built the town's [[Dun Kithas Magistrate|Council Hall]], as well as the fortifications of [[Baggoth's Wall]] and [[Baggoth's Rampart]]. During the [[Second War]], Baggoth took charge of the defense of the Grim Reaches against the [[Dragonmaw clan]], defeating the orcs in many battles until he was felled by an orcish arrow during the Dragonmaw's retreat from the Grim Reaches.<ref name="Sternhand" /> His personal banner was adopted by the [[Wildhammer clan]] as their standard.<ref name="Dragonmaw War" />
